source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Ensuring airway/breathing support, administering rapid-acting antiepileptic medication per protocol, and identifying/treating any underlying cause","B":"Delaying any active treatment until a full neurological workup has first been completed and reviewed for the client","C":"Waiting to see whether the seizure activity happens to resolve entirely on its own without any active intervention from the care team","D":"Assuming fairly little urgency is needed in this situation, since this condition is generally thought to resolve without treatment on its own"}}
source_row.rationale: Status epilepticus is a neurological emergency requiring immediate management, including ensuring airway/breathing support, administering rapid-acting antiepileptic medication (such as a benzodiazepine) per protocol, and identifying/treating any underlying cause, given the significant risk of neurological injury with prolonged, uncontrolled seizure activity.
source_row.source_detail: Emergency Management Priorities for Status Epilepticus
